    Validate a complete result record

    Source: R/result.R
    mssr_validate_result.Rd

    Checks values, geometry, settings, engine identity and diagnostic consistency. This establishes the stored contract, not image authenticity, numerical recomputation, scientific validation or a calibrated confidence estimate. Coordinate and mask functions retain their narrower matrix/grid validation.

    Usage

    mssr_validate_result(result)

    Arguments

    result

    A result returned by mssr().

    Value

    The validated result invisibly, unchanged.

    Details

    Results without a schema field are treated as legacy records; they must still have the original six documented fields. Their engine identity is retained. Schema 1.0.0 adds explicit unknown input calibration and a separate evidence status. Unknown schema versions and unexpected fields are refused.

    Examples

    r <- mssr(matrix(1:20, 4, 5), fwhm = 2)
mssr_validate_result(r)
